subject: S18 done: offline week integrated (f4503936 + c988af2f); precache 4.35 MB/5 MB; airplane-mode day e2e 2x green on WebKit iPad/phone + Chromium
body:
# S18 done — offline week (PWA, Download this week, Dexie outbox, LWW sync, conflicts)

## What landed: f4503936 (feature, migration 0038) + c988af2f (precache 5 MB) on claude/naadi-shared
CI for f4503936: https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/44087773502 (lead: done without waiting for CI; evidence below is local)
- **Outbox** `apps/web/src/offline/` (Dexie `naadi-v1`): one `outbox` table (op_id uuidv7 = Idempotency-Key, entity, key, body, client_updated_at_ms, attempts, next_at, state queued/sending/failed, last_error), coalescing per (entity, key), new op id whenever a sent op changes, FIFO per entity / parallel across entities with `after` deps, backoff 2 s–5 min ±20 %, 4xx (≠408/409/425/429) parked with Retry/Discard, `conflicts` kept 7 days, triggers: online / visible / start / 30 s. Every write goes through it, online or not (`submit`).
- **Entities**: attempt (first answer stands; 409 section_ended/finished → "Not counted: time was up"), card_review (append, FIFO), reading_position (LWW), note + notebook (S13 rules, storage folded), ink (S12b InkSync unchanged, storage folded; headless InkSync sends ink left on another surface), plan_item (S16 queue taken over), user_pathway_task + cost (S17 rules, storage folded). Legacy stores migrated once and deleted: practice + cards + plan localStorage queues, naadi-notes, naadi-notebooks, naadi-ink, naadi-pathway, Cache Storage naadi-reader-v1.
- **Server**: migration `0038_sync.py` (down 0037) (sync_tombstones, sync_ops backend-only, client_updated_at_ms on notes/notebooks; RLS + grants in the file; live_check + RLS coverage updated), `naadi_api/sync` (decide/apply_lww + 26 golden vectors shared with TS in packages/shared/fixtures/lww_vectors.json, Idempotency-Key replay cache incl. 409 idempotency_in_progress, daily GC 24 h / 90 d), LWW notes/notebooks (applied, 409 sync_deleted with tombstone), `GET /api/offline/week` from the online serializers (ChapterDetail, BlockDetail, QuestionView, DueResponse, NoteList, NotebookDetail, InkLayerOut, plan, pathway; per-part bytes; writes nothing).
- **Web**: offlineFirst reads (networkMode offlineFirst + naadi-v1 fallback) for chapter/positions/courses/blocks/questions/labs/due/today/notes; Settings → Offline (size preview, progress, "Ready offline until <day>", remove, persisted yes/no + Keep, storage estimate, install/iOS hint); Today secondary action; global sync line (icon + word: Offline · N changes will sync / Syncing… / All changes saved / N need attention) + sync sheet; "Changed on another device"; tutor offline "Explanation after you reconnect"; first standalone launch → storage.persist().
- **Service worker** (`sw.ts` under S16's marker → `offline/sw/caching.ts`): **precache ≤ 5 MB, enforced at build** (`offline/sw/precache.ts`: static closures from the Vite manifest of the shell/Today, Learn courses + reader + notes panel, ink + highlights, Practice builder/question + exam view, Cards, Notes, Notebooks, the assistant surface + Streamdown/math/KaTeX, and their fonts): **4.35 MB / 171 entries**. Every other chunk/asset (admin, authoring, pathway, generation, library PDF viewer, diagram engines, whiteboard) is CacheFirst on first use, LRU 600, purge on quota error. NavigationRoute → /index.html (never /api); content-public figures CacheFirst (300). The worker never touches /api (no cache, no handler), no vault/signed/authenticated Storage, no YouTube. `pwa/register.ts` + "New version ready · Reload" (hidden during an exam; SKIP_WAITING on tap). No "make everything available offline" option was added.
- **What the earlier 21.6 MB was** (all build output; no source maps, models or PDFs in the bundle): shared/app chunks 9.4 MB, Mermaid + diagram engines (elk, cytoscape, dagre) 4.2, pdf.js 3.5, Excalidraw 1.7, Inter font files (@expo-google-fonts, all weights) 1.3, app PDF export 1.1, KaTeX 0.7, assistant 0.4, admin/review 0.2 (Shiki grammars 7.3 MB were already excluded). Candidates for the bundle itself (not S18's): two KaTeX versions bundled (0.16.47 and 0.18.10), and @expo-google-fonts/inter shipping every weight next to @fontsource-variable/inter.
- **e2e**: the 6-viewport projects now block service workers by default (`page.route` can't see requests from a page the worker controls); `offline.spec.ts` and the planner push test allow it.

## Tests
- Integrate gate (lint, typecheck, test, pytest not live/not db) at c988af2f: green (pytest 1846 passed, 1 skipped; web vitest 798).
- Regression (WebKit iPad portrait + Chromium laptop): notebooks, learn, qbank, planner, generation, settings, cards, shell, ink-sync, today: all green except WebKit flakes that also occur with the worker blocked (generation:166 'Importing a module script failed', notebooks:316 'access control checks'; both pass 3/3 on rerun).
- db (fresh local stack, migrated + seeded): sync, offline, notes, cards, plan, pathway, RLS, RLS coverage, live_check, schema doc: green.
- vitest: outbox engine (coalescing, FIFO, deps, backoff, parking, retry/discard, conflict retention + 7-day purge, op-id renewal, reload), LWW golden vectors, leak guard, download + full-store leak scan, SW rules, precache selection, migrations of every legacy store, note/pathway/plan conflict paths, headless ink.
- e2e `offline.spec.ts` (smoke set 2× `--retries=0`, webkit-ipad-portrait/landscape, webkit-phone-390, chromium-laptop-1440: 8/8 at c988af2f): download the week → leak scan IndexedDB + Cache Storage → reload with the SW in control → offline → offline reload (shell from SW) → 10 tutor answers + 10 card ratings offline → sync sheet → online → all synced once, no double count.

## Checklist
- Copy: every string a ui_copy key (sync.*, offline.*, settings.nav_offline), REQUIRED keys + defaults regenerated, `offline` root in noHardcodedCopy. Server returns codes only.
- One lime CTA per view (Today's download is secondary); sync status icon + word; no colour-only.
- Leaks: no answer/explanation/why-not/objective in any device store before an attempt synced (guard on every write + scans); SW caches no API response.
- RLS + grants in the migration; single head (0038 on 0037); RLS coverage + live_check updated.
- No LLM/web call added; note and ink bodies never logged; vault never queued or cached.
- Screens: test-results/screens/18/* (settings preview/ready, reload-offline, tutor-offline, cards-offline, sync sheet) at iPad portrait/landscape and phone.

## Decisions
- Delegated entities (notes, notebooks, ink, pathway/costs): their proven send rules kept, storage unified in the one outbox table; the scheduler runs their flush.
- reading_positions keeps S06's timestamptz `client_updated_at` (tie → server now).
- Conflict losers kept 7 days; a refused online write is shown inline and its copy kept in the conflict log.
- Download writes the same keys the screens already fall back to (no second read path).
- Precache excludes code-highlighting grammars (assistant needs a connection).

## Known / not S18
- qbank.spec 'a search hit opens…' WebKit flake seen with the 21 MB precache: 12/12 with the 5 MB precache.
- notes db test_delete_removes_index_rows: race with the background re-index under a full run; passes alone (3/3).
- shell.spec 'no dead links': a 'Search the web' button on another segment's page (not S18).
- WebKit "[Report Only] Trusted Types" console lines failed other specs' console guards (S22, being handled).
- planner push-notification e2e fails with or without S18's caching (headless notification permission); ICS 404 is planner-side.
- Two-browser note conflict e2e not written; covered by unit tests (both orders) + server db tests through the real endpoints.
